'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Mike Tomashewski DS Separatist Uprising''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Tomashewski]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).

Typed printout (not a handwritten Xerox form).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Separatist Uprising / At War With Itself]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
